design.name: 连鼓灵
design.brief: The Liangu (连鼓灵), a living fragment of the legendary thunder drum made from the hide of Kui: a hovering ring about 2.4 m across of SIX small barrel drums with weathered copper studs and grey-blue hide heads painted with spiral cloud-and-thunder patterns, evenly spaced and joined by a ring of twisted bronze; one of the six drums is lacquered red. At the centre a glowing magenta-violet thunder core (weak spot) is held in a cage of pale beast bone, and one long drumstick carved from a beast bone hangs from the ring. It floats with nothing below it. An animated object: no face, no limbs, no person.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
